headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY
summary: As of August 7, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY with an average return of 25.88% compared to SPY's 13.93%. This 11.95% average alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 45.87%, contributing significantly to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 15.50%, which still reflects a positive outcome relative to SPY. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress, as it suggests resilience against broader market fluctuations. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
